notes: Independent manual source audit of all 55 eligible production TypeScript files and both package/manifest metadata files. No Inspector implementation, helpers, output, or other plugin fixtures were read. Source bytes under extensions/anthropic match the pinned commit.

All local production imports remain within extensions/anthropic; no additional plugin-owned/shared shipped source crosses its root. SDK implementation files were consulted only to verify public exports and type provenance, without recursively auditing their dependencies or inferring helper internals.

Source phase includes setup-api.ts and lightweight api.ts, cli-auth-api.ts, contract-api.ts, provider-contract-api.ts, provider-policy-api.ts, and doctor-contract-api.ts regardless of runtime reachability. Their reexports refer to plugin-owned functions/constants, not SDK symbols. Package metadata names index.ts and declares only a development workspace SDK dependency; installed Claude Code runtime artifacts are outside this source population.

The four excluded *.test-support.ts files have only test callers: cli-runtime.test.ts, index.test.ts, server-compaction.live.test.ts/server-compaction-live.test-support.test.ts, and session-catalog.test.ts respectively. contract-api.ts remains included as a shipped local API barrel even though its comment mentions contract tests.

Imported aliases retain original exported names: ProviderAuthConfig is provider-auth#OpenClawConfig; readBoundedString is string-coerce-runtime#normalizeBoundedOptionalString; pullRequestNumber is string-coerce-runtime#asPositiveSafeInteger. Unused/callback-only dependencies remain imports; validateClaudeSessionId is passed to an SDK helper, with no plugin-source call inferred.

definePluginEntry's register callback and explicitly typed OpenClawPluginApi parameters establish the API provenance. api.runtime propagation through catalog helpers reaches PluginRuntime nodes.list/nodes.invoke; propagation into known SDK helpers does not invent internal runtime paths. OpenClawPluginApi['runtime'] names the root handle only, so no runtime-root or api.runtime duplicate is emitted.
PluginRuntime['nodes']['list'] in session-catalog-listing.ts contributes the maximal runtime.nodes.list type reference in addition to actual calls. No prefixes such as runtime.nodes are invented.

ProviderAuthContext.runtime and ProviderAuthMethodNonInteractiveContext.runtime are RuntimeEnv, not PluginRuntime (src/plugins/provider-authentication.types.ts:62,133). Their log calls are not plugin-runtime members. Provider model contexts, CLI backend execution contexts, native CLI session handles, watch subscriptions, transcript writer contexts, and SDK function return objects likewise are not OpenClawPluginApi/PluginRuntime handles.

register.runtime.ts:66 dynamically loads the whole provider-catalog-live-runtime namespace through createLazyRuntimeModule; preserve its * dependency. The selector at line 67 adds the named buildOpenAICompatibleProviderCatalog dynamic-import/member-access dependency. Its later invocation is through createLazyRuntimeMethod's returned wrapper, so no call to that original SDK export is inferred. The local lazy auth/stream/catalog modules contain plugin-owned exports.

streamSimple is the unchanged fallback value assigned to underlying in stream-wrappers.ts:53 (also 153,174,224); the subsequent underlying invocation supplies call evidence. Calls and object selections on other SDK helper return values do not acquire SDK-export or runtime-member paths.

createDeferred and createProviderUsageDailyAccumulator are mixed SDK-export dependencies because explicit typeof type queries coexist with their value imports/calls. Later type usage does not add type-import to their modules.
sessionCatalogPaging.boundTranscriptPage calls a member of the imported SDK object and contributes call to the sessionCatalogPaging export, without inventing a public API/runtime path.

Claude UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse protocol callbacks and provider hook properties are not api.on/registerHook registrations. Anthropic has no hook findings. Manifest identities are limited to providers and contracts.mediaUnderstandingProviders/contracts.usageProviders; cliBackends, setup metadata, catalog entries, and descriptive/config fields are outside the agreed manifest-contract identity set.

Every finding's referenceKinds merges all manually reviewed source occurrence kinds; evidence includes representative dependency and call/type/member sites. No genuinely unresolved SDK/API/runtime reference remains.

Source-only reconciliation: session-catalog-registration.ts:163 passes api.pluginConfig unchanged to isClaudeSessionCatalogEnabled. The unknown parameter annotation, object guard, and assertion preserve that original object at line 35, which reads api.pluginConfig.sessionCatalog. The sessionCatalog local aliases that nested original value, and the guard/assertion at line 39 preserve provenance for api.pluginConfig.sessionCatalog.enabled. Both are member-access findings; the helper call and its boolean result add no API call or returned-object provenance. The separate api.pluginConfig access at line 163 remains.

Source-only reconciliation: currentClaudeSessionCatalogConfig in session-catalog-runtime.ts:12–13 returns api.config unchanged on its nullish fallback branch. The cast and alternate runtime.config.current()/{} branches do not erase that provenance. session-catalog-continue.ts:126 retains the result as config, and line 160 reads the maximal api.config.session.store member path; no incidental api.config.session prefix or runtime-return member path is added.

The lazy local-module selector is statically resolvable: session-catalog-registration.ts:62–64 passes a literal import of ./session-catalog.js to createLazyRuntimeSurface and selects module.createClaudeSessionCatalogRuntime(api). The helper signature in src/shared/lazy-runtime.ts:5–7 ties the selector module to the importer result, and session-catalog.ts:170–172 exports that plugin-owned function with an OpenClawPluginApi parameter. This is no opaque API escape, so it adds no unknown or SDK-export identity for the local function.
